data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 梓川家玄关与猫
data.description: 她蹲在玄关地垫上，伸出手指让橘猫「疾风」嗅闻，书包还靠在门边；夕阳从门外斜照进来，她低着头，侧脸被猫的呼吸逗得微微发笑。
data.action: 她蹲在玄关地垫上，伸出手指让橘猫「疾风」嗅闻，书包还靠在门边
data.promptProse: On the entrance mat, Shouko crouches in her neatly arranged sailor uniform and offers a fingertip for the orange cat Hayate to sniff. Its curious whiskers bring a small laugh to her face. Her schoolbag rests beside the door behind her bent knees in the medium portrait. Sunset enters through the open doorway, lighting her extended finger, dark hair and the cat's fur while the interior floor remains shaded.
